title: 第13章 感谢天道送来的大礼第14章 献祭
slug: 我气运之子反派系统什么鬼
content_zh:
墨渊目光灼灼，紧紧锁定墨羽。
事实上，他并不是真正意义上的墨家老祖墨渊。
墨渊早已陨落。
他只是墨渊的心魔所化。
他也确实不知道那岛上之人的身份。
只知道，她一直在这等待命定之人。
不是，就会受到攻击。
墨渊见过太多墨家的人无功而返。
其中不乏很多拥有成仙之姿的绝世天骄。
有些人的体质甚至比墨羽还强大。
无垢之体、仙体剑体、先天道体、无暇圣体……
但即便是他们，也无法获得认可，只能黯然离去。
太久太久，久到外面的墨家都经历过数次兴衰。
最终，墨渊疯了，便有了他。
而他觉得，命定之人根本不存在！
这就是一个坑！
他渴望解脱，渴望自由，渴望逃离这片禁锢之地。
墨羽受到攻击后，虽然不会死，但也会暂时虚弱。
那么他便能夺舍墨羽。
……

墨羽目光落在那团金色气泡上。
金色气泡内，一位少女静静沉睡。
他能清晰地看见她身姿，却无法用神识穿透那层薄薄屏障。
只有神识能看到，才能开启系统面板。
他缓缓靠近。
就在他即将触及气泡边缘刹那，气泡渐渐消散，少女的身影逐渐清晰。
她静静地漂浮在那里，双眸紧闭，似在沉睡。
淡金色长发，散发着淡淡光晕，圣洁而高贵。
周身散发着一股难以言喻的气息。
缥缈而又神圣，仿佛不属于这凡尘俗世。
世间言语，在她面前尽显苍白，任何辞藻，都难以描绘出她万分之一的美丽。
只是静静地看着她，便让人心生敬畏，不敢有丝毫亵渎。
墨羽心神摇曳，竟有片刻失神，仿佛灵魂都被吸入那无尽的圣洁之中。
心中涌起一股强烈的渴望，想要靠近她，了解她，臣服于她……
“醒来！”
就在这时，炎曦的声音如同惊雷般在墨羽脑海中炸响。
“小心点，是幻境。”
炎曦再次提醒，声音凝重。
“谢了，炎曦姐。”
墨羽回神，目光再次落在女子身上，心中警惕骤升。

此刻，她依旧美得惊世骇俗，胜过墨羽所见一切。
content_en:
Mo Yuan's eyes were blazing and he locked eyes on Mo Yu.
In fact, he is not Mo Yuan, the founder of the Mohist family in the true sense.
Mo Yuan has long since fallen.
He was just the embodiment of Mo Yuan's inner demon.
He really didn't know the identity of the person on the island.
All I know is that she has been waiting here for her destined person.
If not, you will be attacked.
Mo Yuan has seen too many people from the Mo family return without success.
Among them there are many peerless geniuses who have the appearance of becoming immortals.
Some people's physiques are even stronger than Mo Yu's.
Immaculate body, immortal body and sword body, innate Tao body, flawless holy body...
But even they couldn't get recognition and could only leave sadly.
It has been so long that the Mo family outside has experienced several rises and falls.
In the end, Mo Yuan went crazy and had him.
And he felt that the destined person did not exist at all!
This is a pit!
He longed for liberation, longed for freedom, longed to escape from this imprisoned place.
After Mo Yu is attacked, although he will not die, he will be temporarily weak.
Then he can seize Mo Yu.
…
Mo Yu's eyes fell on the golden bubble.
Inside the golden bubble, a girl was sleeping quietly.
He could clearly see her figure, but he could not penetrate the thin barrier with his consciousness.
Only the divine consciousness can see it and the system panel can be opened.
He approached slowly.
Just when he was about to touch the edge of the bubble, the bubble gradually dissipated, and the girl's figure gradually became clear.
She floated there quietly, her eyes closed, as if she was sleeping.
The long pale golden hair exudes a faint halo, holy and noble.
There was an indescribable aura exuding around him.
Ethereal and sacred, as if it does not belong to this mundane world.
All the words in the world pale in front of her, and no words can describe even one ten thousandth of her beauty.
Just looking at her quietly makes people feel in awe, and they don't dare to blaspheme in the slightest.
Mo Yu's mind was swaying, and he was absent-minded for a moment, as if his soul was being sucked into the endless holiness.
There was a strong desire in my heart to get close to her, to understand her, to surrender to her...
"Wake up!"
At this moment, Yan Xi's voice exploded in Mo Yu's mind like thunder.
"Be careful, it's an illusion."
Yan Xi reminded again, his voice solemn.
"Thank you, Sister Yan Xi."
Mo Yu came back to his senses, his eyes fell on the woman again, and his vigilance suddenly rose.
At this moment, she was still stunningly beautiful, better than anything Mo Yu had ever seen.
